docs.title: 3. 統合の仕組み
docs.text:
コアの各部品とサブシステムには、RCOSDP 組織内に非公開の「統合リポジトリ」を一つずつ作ります。名前は RDM-<name>-dev2027 です。その develop ブランチをインストーラーが組みます。横に「追跡ブランチ」（他の場所のブランチを読み取り専用で写したもの）を、マニフェストに載せた上流ごとに一本置きます。名前は upstream/<kind>-<branch> で、<branch> は上流のブランチ名の / を - に置き換えたものです（SPEC-01 §4 の規則 7）。

  • upstream/public-<branch> — 公開 RCOSDP リポジトリの既定ブランチ。例: upstream/public-develop（osf.io、waterbutler、mfr、cas-overlay、wiki-frontend）、upstream/public-master（ember-osf-web、y-websocket）。
  • upstream/private-<branch> — -private セキュリティ検証版の既定ブランチ。例: upstream/private-develop、upstream/private-master（ember-osf-web、y-websocket）、upstream/private-main（OASys、Shibboleth-SP、rdmcp、aipf_mcp_data_grdm。公開の上流がないので、この一本だけ）。
  • upstream/cos-develop — COS 本家。参照専用（wiki-frontend を除くコア 5 本）。
  • 同じ kind の上流が二つあるときはタグを挟みます。upstream/private-sec-test-fix-sec-test は RDM-osf.io-private（ブランチ fix/sec-test）を、マージしない候補として写したものです。
flowchart LR
  PUB["RDM-<name>（公開）<br/>既定ブランチ"] -->|ミラー| UP1["upstream/public-<branch>"]
  PRV["RDM-<name>-*-private<br/>既定ブランチ"] -->|ミラー| UP2["upstream/private-<branch>"]
  COS["CenterForOpenScience/<name><br/>develop"] -->|ミラー| UP3["upstream/cos-develop（参照）"]
  UP1 -->|1. マージ| DEV["RDM-<name>-dev2027<br/>develop"]
  UP2 -->|2. マージ| DEV
  PRS["採用 PR<br/>（マニフェストに列挙）"] -->|3. 適用| DEV
  UP3 -.->|比較のみ| DEV
  DEV -->|インストーラーが組む| IMG["ローカルのイメージ"]

順番が大事です。公開版、次に private 版、最後に採用 PR。マニフェスト（SPEC-01）が各段のコミットを SHA（コミットの 40 文字の指紋）で記録します。これを毎日・毎週保つ仕事は SPEC-05 に、なぜこの置き方にしたかは ADR-01 にあります。

docs.title: 4. ネットワークの形
docs.text:
• 旧手引きのループバック別名 192.168.168.167 は 廃止 しました。sudo（管理者権限）が要り、サービスが LAN に見えてしまうからです。
  • コンテナ同士は Compose の内部ネットワーク（一つのプロジェクトのコンテナだけが見える私設の網）でサービス名を使って話します。例: http://api:8000。
  • ホストに公開するポートは 127.0.0.1（「このコンピュータだけ」を意味する番地）に結び付けたものだけです。他のインターフェースでは何も待ち受けません。
  • 導入のどの手順にも sudo は要りません。理由は ADR-02 にあります。

docs.title: 5. 節目のはしご
docs.text:
「節目（マイルストーン）」は合否の試験がある関門です。「セキュリティ門」はそのビルドを導入してよいかを決める試験で、節目ごとに厳しくなります（ADR-03）。

milestones[5]{id,goal,security_gate}:
  M1,"docs の骨格・manifest・dev2027 リポジトリ群がある。レビュー済み PR が develop にマージ済み","報告＋許容リスト"
  M2,"コア 6 本が Mac Studio で一発導入。Playwright 受入合格。amd64 ビルド確認","報告＋許容リスト（M1 より件数を減らす）"
  M3,"サブシステム 5 本が起動。各 1 本の正常系＋拒否ケース","報告＋許容リスト（M2 より件数を減らす）"
  M4,"waterbutler・mfr・osf.io を Python 3.13 へ","HIGH 以上で停止。AI レッドチーム初回"
  M5,"ES2・mongo 廃止。ES8＋postgres 15 以降。海外配布可","CRITICAL/HIGH ゼロ。AI レッドチームの未解決経路ゼロ"

docs.title: 6. 役割
docs.text:
役割の略称は AGENTS.md の対応表に従います。「AI エージェント」は、指示を読み、コードや文書を書き、結果を報告するプログラムです。

略称 誰 何をする AID（AI開発担当者） Orca の Open Code 2 ワーカー（ローカル LLM） 仕様どおりに実装する。文書とコードを PR で出す QAE（QA担当） Claude Code Fable 仕様を書く。実装を検査する。回帰・受入試験を実行し判定する REV（担当レビュワ） Codex Astra 全 PR の独立レビュー。結果を docs/reviews/ と PR コメントに残す 所有者 人 方針を決める。受け入れる。マージし公開する

検出、修正 PR、レビュー、自動試験までは人が介在しません。マージと公開は必ず所有者が行います（ADR-04）。

docs.title: 7. 仕様の索引
docs.text: ID ファイル 一行説明 SPEC-01 01_manifest.md マニフェスト。インストーラーが組む上流のコミットと PR SPEC-02 02_installer_cli.md grdm-dev CLI と install.sh。ホスト判定・秘密・compose・ビルド・健康確認・報告 SPEC-03 03_security_gate.md SBOM、CVE スキャン、静的解析、ZAP、AI レッドチームと節目ごとの基準 SPEC-04 04_acceptance_tests.md Playwright Python の受入。機能ごとの正常系と拒否ケース SPEC-05 05_upstream_tracking.md 日次ミラーと差分報告、週次の AI 統合 PR、COS の参照追跡 SPEC-06 06_documentation_conventions.md すべての文書の書き方

docs.title: Glossary / 用語
docs.text: Term English note 日本語注 Container A box that holds one program and everything it needs, so it runs the same anywhere. 一つのプログラムと必要なものを一箱に入れ、どこでも同じように動かす箱。 Base image The ready-made operating-system layer a program is built on. プログラムを載せる土台になる、できあいの OS の層。 Upstream The original repository we copy code from. コードを写してくる元のリポジトリ。 Tracking branch A read-only copy of a branch that lives somewhere else. 他の場所にあるブランチの読み取り専用の写し。 SHA The 40-character fingerprint that names one commit. 一つのコミットを指す 40 文字の指紋。 Loopback / 127.0.0.1 The network address that means "this computer only". 「このコンピュータだけ」を意味する番地。 Security gate The test that decides whether a build may be installed. ビルドを導入してよいかを決める試験。 Milestone A checkpoint with a pass/fail test. 合否の試験がある関門。

docs.title: SPEC-01 Upstream Manifest / 上流マニフェスト
docs.text:
Summary: The manifest is the single source of truth for what the installer builds: every component, its upstream repositories pinned to exact commits, the pull requests we adopt, the base and target images, and the profiles and platforms. This page defines its schema, its rules, and the checks that grdm-dev manifest check runs. 概要: マニフェストは「インストーラーが何を組むか」の唯一の正本です。全部品、固定したコミットの上流、採用する PR、現行と目標のイメージ、プロファイルと対応アーキテクチャを持ちます。この文書はその形、規則、grdm-dev manifest check の検査項目を定めます。

Jump: English · 日本語

  • Version / 版: 0.5 — 2026-11-05. Learned: the second real install on Apple Silicon showed that a Dockerfile whose base image is a schema-1 manifest cannot be built by current Docker at all, so a digest-pinned prebuilt_image fallback is needed per component, with a note and an M4 removal date, because it bypasses the build-from-pinned-source guarantee. ／ Apple Silicon での二度目の実導入で、ベースイメージが schema 1 のマニフェストである Dockerfile は現行 Docker ではまったく組めないと分かった。だから「固定した元から組む」保証を外す代わりに、理由と M4 での撤去を書いた note を伴うダイジェスト固定の prebuilt_image が部品ごとに要る。 0.4 — 2026-11-05. Learned: the first real build on Apple Silicon showed that an EOL Python 3.5 base cannot install pandas 0.25.1 for arm64, so a per-component build_platform is needed until M4 modernizes those images. ／ Apple Silicon での最初の実ビルドで、EOL の Python 3.5 ベースは arm64 向け pandas 0.25.1 を入れられないと分かった。M4 で近代化するまで部品ごとの build_platform が要る。 0.3 — 2026-11-05. Learned: building from "the tip of develop" is not reproducible unless the manifest pins that tip, so each component needs an integration_sha (nullable until the first strict merge). ／ 「develop の先端」から組むのでは再現できないため、各部品に integration_sha（最初の厳密マージまでは null 可）が要ると分かった。 0.2 — 2026-11-05. Learned: a TOON block that is only an example must say so, or readers and the checker treat it as data that has to stay in step with the JSON. ／ 例にすぎない TOON ブロックはそう明記しないと、読者も検査も JSON と一致させるべきデータとして扱ってしまうと分かった。
  • Version / 版: 0.1 — 2026-11-05. Learned: the public osf.io develop (2026-11-05) is already newer than its -private twin (2026-11-02), so "the latest" is not one answer; only a file that pins each upstream to a SHA can say what "consistent" means. ／ 公開 osf.io の develop（2026-11-05）は -private（2026-11-02）より既に新しく、「最新」は一つに決まらない。各上流を SHA で固定したファイルがあってこそ「矛盾なく」を定義できると分かった。
  • Normative for: manifest/upstreams.json (canonical), manifest/upstreams.toon (excerpt), manifest/README.md, the manifest subcommand of grdm-dev (SPEC-02), and every document that quotes the manifest.
  • Related: SPEC-00 Overview · SPEC-05 Upstream tracking · SPEC-06 Documentation conventions · POL-01 Position · ADR-01 Integration repository placement · ADR-03 Staged security gate · docs/README.md

docs.title: English
docs.text: → 日本語版へ

docs.title: 1. What the manifest is
docs.text:
A manifest is a packing list: it says exactly what goes into the box. Ours says, for every component of the environment (SPEC-00 §2), which upstream repositories (the original places we copy code from) are combined, at which SHA (the 40-character fingerprint of one commit), and which pull requests (PRs, proposed changes waiting to be merged) we add on top.

The installer reads the manifest and nothing else to decide what to build. If a fact is not in the manifest, the installer does not know it.

docs.title: 2. Files
docs.text:
File Role manifest/upstreams.json Canonical. The only file machines trust. JSON, UTF-8, two-space indent, keys sorted. manifest/upstreams.toon Excerpt in TOON (a compact text form of JSON that people read easily; SPEC-06 §4). Generated from the JSON by grdm-dev manifest toon. Must always equal the JSON. manifest/README.md Explains the two files for readers, bilingual.

The excerpt contains the top-level fields and, for every component, id, role, integration_repo, profile, every field of upstreams[], and adopted_prs[] reduced to repo, number, status. It omits candidate_prs, images, services, and platforms. Other files under manifest/ (allowlist.json, allowlist.baseline.json, milestone.json, hardening.json, redteam-targets.json) are defined by SPEC-03; their file list is in SPEC-02 §9.

Warning: This repository is public. The manifest contains repository names and SHAs only. It never contains URLs to private repositories, access tokens, or code fragments from -private repositories. The CI secret scan fails the PR if it finds any.

docs.title: 3. Schema
docs.text:
The top level has schema_version (integer, currently 1), generated_at (ISO date), an optional note (free text), and components[]. Infrastructure images (databases, queues, fakecas) are components with role: infra. Each component has:

Field Type Meaning id string Short name, same as in SPEC-00 §2. Unique. role core | infra | subsystem What kind of component. COS repositories are not components; they appear as upstreams[] entries with kind: cos. services[] list The Compose service names the component provides, as used in SPEC-02 §4 (for example web, api, admin, worker for osf.io). Never empty. integration_repo string or null Name of the private integration repository, RDM-<name>-dev2027. Name only, never a URL. null for infra. integration_branch string or null Always develop; null for infra. integration_sha string (40 hex) or null The commit at the tip of the integration branch develop that this manifest pins. grdm-dev build and compose render use it for image tags. May be null until the strict reconstruction PRs are merged; required for M2 acceptance. build_platform string or absent Platform used to build and run this component's image, for example linux/amd64. Absent means the host platform. grdm-dev build --platform overrides it. Components whose EOL base has no arm64 wheels (modular-file-renderer, ember-osf-web, cas-overlay until M4) set linux/amd64; Compose then runs them under emulation. Must be null or absent for infra. prebuilt_image string or absent A registry image reference pinned by digest (name@sha256:<64 hex>, for example niicloudoperation/rdm-ember-osf-web@sha256:…) that is run instead of building from the integration repository. Allowed only together with a note that says why the build is impossible and until which milestone the fallback stays; never a URL or a private-repository reference; not allowed for infra. grdm-dev build records the component as prebuilt, pulls the reference and does not clone or build; compose render writes it as image: (with platform: from build_platform); scan treats it like any other compose image. A prebuilt image bypasses the "build from pinned source" guarantee of this specification: nobody can show which commits are inside it. It is a temporary measure for M2 and must be removed by M4. Current use: ember-osf-web, whose Dockerfile base quay.io/centerforopenscience/ember-base is a Docker image manifest v2 schema 1 image that current Docker refuses to pull. upstreams[] list Each: repo (name), branch, kind (public | private | cos), tracking_branch (named by rule 7), status (merged | reference | candidate), sha (40 lowercase hex), fetched_at (ISO date). Empty for infra. adopted_prs[] list Each: repo, number, title, reason, status (adopted). PRs applied on top of the merged upstreams. candidate_prs[] list Same shape; status is candidate or rejected. Not built. base_image string The image the component builds from today (for example python:3.6-slim). For infra, the image that is run. base_image_digest string or null The sha256: digest of base_image once pinned (SPEC-03 §3.4); null until then. target_image object Keys M4 and M5, each the image planned at that milestone (a milestone is a checkpoint; SPEC-00 §5), or null when nothing changes at that milestone. profile minimum | core | full The smallest installer profile that includes the component (SPEC-02 §4). platforms[] list Subset of linux/arm64, linux/amd64. note string or null Optional free text (for example "mutually exclusive with fakecas").

Example for one component, in TOON:

schema_version: 1
generated_at: 2026-11-05
note: "Names and SHAs only."
components[1]:
  - id: waterbutler
    role: core
    services[2]: wb,wb_worker
    integration_repo: RDM-waterbutler-dev2027
    integration_branch: develop
    upstreams[3]{repo,branch,kind,tracking_branch,status,sha,fetched_at}:
      RDM-waterbutler,develop,public,upstream/public-develop,merged,0000000000000000000000000000000000000000,2026-11-05
      RDM-waterbutler-develop-private,develop,private,upstream/private-develop,merged,0000000000000000000000000000000000000000,2026-11-05
      CenterForOpenScience/waterbutler,develop,cos,upstream/cos-develop,reference,0000000000000000000000000000000000000000,2026-11-05
    adopted_prs[1]{repo,number,title,reason,status}:
      RDM-waterbutler,101,"Python 3.13, dependency update, multi-stage image (WIP)","vulnerability remediation (M4)",adopted
    candidate_prs[1]{repo,number,title,reason,status}:
      RDM-waterbutler,93,"S3 SigV4",feature,candidate
    base_image: python:3.6-slim-buster
    base_image_digest: null
    target_image:
      M4: "python:3.13-slim multi-stage, non-root"
      M5: null
    profile: core
    platforms[2]: linux/arm64,linux/amd64
    note: null

The all-zero SHAs above are placeholders for the example only; a real manifest never contains them. The block is an illustrative example, not a mirror of manifest/upstreams.json, so it carries no <!-- canonical: ... --> declaration (SPEC-06 §4); blocks that do mirror the manifest (for example in SPEC-00 §2) declare it.

docs.title: 4. Rules
docs.text:
1. SHAs are pinned. Every upstreams[].sha is a real 40-character commit that exists on the named branch at fetched_at. Branch names alone are never enough.
  2. A change to the manifest is a PR. Nobody edits upstreams.json on develop directly. The weekly integration PR (SPEC-05 §3) is the normal way SHAs move. Adopting or rejecting a PR is also a manifest PR, with the reason filled in.
  3. Integration order is fixed: merge the public upstream with status: merged, then the private one, then apply adopted_prs in list order. A component that has no public upstream (the private subsystems) starts from its private upstream. The cos upstream (status: reference) is never merged; it is compared.
  4. "Consistent" (矛盾なく) means all of the following:
  5. No two components reference two different SHAs of the same upstream repository and branch.
  6. Every adopted_prs[] entry applies cleanly (no conflict) on the integration branch built from the pinned upstreams.
  7. upstreams.toon is byte-for-byte what grdm-dev manifest toon produces from upstreams.json.
  8. Every integration_repo named exists and has the branch develop plus one tracking branch per upstreams[] entry, named exactly as its tracking_branch.
  9. Names only. repo and integration_repo are bare names (RDM-osf.io-dev2027). A value starting with http, git@, or containing github.com is invalid.
  10. Undecided upstreams are listed with status: candidate. They are mirrored to their tracking branch but not merged. Example: RDM-osf.io-private (branch fix/sec-test, tracking branch upstream/private-sec-test-fix-sec-test) is a candidate until the owner decides (plan §7).
  11. Tracking branches are named by one rule: upstream/<kind>-<branch>, where <branch> is the upstream branch name with every / replaced by -. When one component lists two upstreams of the same kind, the second inserts a short tag after the kind: upstream/<kind>-<tag>-<branch>. Examples: RDM-ember-osf-web (master) → upstream/public-master; RDM-ember-osf-web-master-private → upstream/private-master; RDM-OASys-main-private → upstream/private-main; CenterForOpenScience/osf.io → upstream/cos-develop; RDM-osf.io-private (fix/sec-test) → upstream/private-sec-test-fix-sec-test. The same rule is stated in SPEC-05 §1 and ADR-01 §3.

docs.title: 5. Validation: grdm-dev manifest check
docs.text:
Run from the repository root. Exit code 0 means pass; any failure prints one line per finding and exits 20 (manifest invalid, SPEC-02 §6).

grdm-dev manifest check

Checks, in order:

checks[13]{id,rule,severity}:
  MC-01,"upstreams.json parses as JSON and matches schema_version 1",error
  MC-02,"every component id is unique and matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$",error
  MC-03,"role is one of core|infra|subsystem; services is a non-empty list",error
  MC-04,"integration_repo matches ^RDM-[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+-dev2027$ or is null for infra",error
  MC-05,"integration_branch is develop, or null for infra",error
  MC-06,"every sha matches ^[0-9a-f]{40}$; base_image_digest is null or sha256:<64 hex>; fetched_at is an ISO date not in the future; prebuilt_image, when present, is name@sha256:<64 hex>, has a non-empty note, is not a URL or private-repository reference, and is not on infra",error
  MC-07,"no value anywhere contains http, git@, github.com, or a token-like string",error
  MC-08,"the same (repo, branch) pair has one sha across all components",error
  MC-09,"adopted_prs status is adopted; candidate_prs status is candidate|rejected; upstreams status is merged|reference|candidate and cos upstreams are reference; number is a positive integer",error
  MC-10,"profile and platforms use only the allowed values; core components list both platforms",error
  MC-11,"upstreams.toon equals the output of grdm-dev manifest toon",error
  MC-12,"with --remote: each integration_repo has develop plus every tracking_branch listed, and each sha is reachable from its tracking_branch",error
  MC-13,"every tracking_branch follows rule 7 (upstream/<kind>[-<tag>]-<branch with / replaced by ->)",error

--remote needs network and credentials and is run in the private -dev2027 CI, not in this public repository's CI. The documentation check in SPEC-06 §8 reuses MC-11 for TOON blocks quoted in documents.

docs.title: 6. Who changes it
docs.text: Change Opened by Reviewed by Merged by Weekly SHA advance AID agent (weekly job, SPEC-05) REV (Codex Astra), check by QAE (Claude Code Fable) Owner Adopt / reject a PR AID or QAE, with reason REV Owner Change target_image QAE, referencing the milestone plan REV Owner

docs.title: 日本語
docs.text: → To English

docs.title: 1. マニフェストとは
docs.text:
「マニフェスト」は荷物の明細書です。箱に何が入るかを正確に書きます。私たちのマニフェストは、環境の全部品（SPEC-00 §2）について、どの上流（コードを写してくる元のリポジトリ）を、どの SHA（一つのコミットを指す 40 文字の指紋）で重ね、どの PR（プルリクエスト。マージを待っている変更の提案）をその上に足すかを書きます。

インストーラーは何を組むかをマニフェストだけから決めます。マニフェストに無いことは、インストーラーは知りません。

docs.title: 2. ファイル
docs.text:
ファイル 役割 manifest/upstreams.json 正本。 機械が信じる唯一のファイル。JSON、UTF-8、字下げ 2 つ、キーは並べ替え済み。 manifest/upstreams.toon TOON（JSON を人が読みやすい短い文字形式にしたもの。SPEC-06 §4）の 抄録。grdm-dev manifest toon が JSON から生成する。常に JSON と一致していなければならない。 manifest/README.md 二つのファイルを読者向けに二言語で説明する。

抄録には、最上位の項目と、各部品の id・role・integration_repo・profile、upstreams[] の全項目、そして repo・number・status に絞った adopted_prs[] を載せます。candidate_prs、イメージ、サービス、platform は載せません。manifest/ の下のほかのファイル（allowlist.json、allowlist.baseline.json、milestone.json、hardening.json、redteam-targets.json）は SPEC-03 が定め、一覧は SPEC-02 §9 にあります。

Warning: このリポジトリは公開です。マニフェストには リポジトリ名と SHA だけ を書きます。非公開リポジトリの URL、アクセストークン、-private 由来のコード断片は決して書きません。CI の秘密スキャンが見つけたら PR は不合格です。

docs.title: 3. 形（スキーマ）
docs.text:
最上位は schema_version（整数。今は 1）、generated_at（ISO 日付）、任意の note（自由記述）、components[] です。基盤のイメージ（データベース、キュー、fakecas）も role: infra の部品として載せます。各部品は次を持ちます。

項目 型 意味 id 文字列 短い名前。SPEC-00 §2 と同じ。重複しない。 role core | infra | subsystem 部品の種類。COS のリポジトリは部品ではなく、kind: cos の upstreams[] 要素として現れる。 services[] 配列 その部品が提供する Compose のサービス名。SPEC-02 §4 と同じ名前（例: osf.io は web、api、admin、worker）。空にしない。 integration_repo 文字列または null 非公開の統合リポジトリの名前 RDM-<name>-dev2027。名前だけで URL は書かない。infra は null。 integration_branch 文字列または null 常に develop。infra は null。 integration_sha 文字列（40 桁の 16 進）または null このマニフェストが固定する統合ブランチ develop の先端のコミット。grdm-dev build と compose render はこの値をイメージのタグに使う。厳密再構築 PR のマージ前は null でよいが、M2 の受入では必須。 build_platform 文字列または省略 この部品のイメージを組んで動かすプラットフォーム。例: linux/amd64。省略時はホストと同じ。grdm-dev build --platform が優先する。EOL ベースで arm64 の wheel がない部品（M4 までの modular-file-renderer・ember-osf-web・cas-overlay）は linux/amd64 を指定し、Compose はエミュレーションで動かす。infra では null か省略。 prebuilt_image 文字列または省略 統合リポジトリから組む 代わりに 動かす、ダイジェストで固定したレジストリのイメージ参照（name@sha256:<16 進 64 文字>。例: niicloudoperation/rdm-ember-osf-web@sha256:…）。なぜ組めないか、どの節目までこの代替を続けるかを書いた note と一緒にしか書けない。URL や非公開リポジトリの参照は不可。infra には使えない。grdm-dev build はその部品を prebuilt として記録し、参照を pull するだけで clone も build もしない。compose render はそれを image: に書き（platform: は build_platform から）、scan はほかの Compose イメージと同じに扱う。事前ビルド済みイメージは、この仕様の「固定した元から組む」保証を外す。中にどのコミットが入っているかを誰も示せない。 M2 のための一時措置であり、M4 までに必ず外す。現在の使用: ember-osf-web。その Dockerfile のベース quay.io/centerforopenscience/ember-base は Docker image manifest v2 schema 1 のイメージで、現行の Docker は pull を拒否する。 upstreams[] 配列 各要素: repo（名前）、branch、kind（public | private | cos）、tracking_branch（規則 7 で命名）、status（merged | reference | candidate）、sha（小文字 16 進 40 文字）、fetched_at（ISO 日付）。infra は空。 adopted_prs[] 配列 各要素: repo、number、title、reason、status（adopted）。上流をマージした上に適用する PR。 candidate_prs[] 配列 同じ形。status は candidate か rejected。組まない。 base_image 文字列 その部品が今日組む元のイメージ（例 python:3.6-slim）。infra では実行するイメージ。 base_image_digest 文字列または null base_image を固定したときの sha256: ダイジェスト（SPEC-03 §3.4）。固定するまでは null。 target_image オブジェクト キー M4 と M5。各節目（合否の試験がある関門。SPEC-00 §5）で予定するイメージ。その節目で変えないなら null。 profile minimum | core | full その部品を含む最小のインストーラープロファイル（SPEC-02 §4）。 platforms[] 配列 linux/arm64、linux/amd64 の部分集合。 note 文字列または null 任意の自由記述（例:「fakecas と排他」）。

一部品の例を TOON で示します。

schema_version: 1
generated_at: 2026-11-05
note: "Names and SHAs only."
components[1]:
  - id: waterbutler
    role: core
    services[2]: wb,wb_worker
    integration_repo: RDM-waterbutler-dev2027
    integration_branch: develop
    upstreams[3]{repo,branch,kind,tracking_branch,status,sha,fetched_at}:
      RDM-waterbutler,develop,public,upstream/public-develop,merged,0000000000000000000000000000000000000000,2026-11-05
      RDM-waterbutler-develop-private,develop,private,upstream/private-develop,merged,0000000000000000000000000000000000000000,2026-11-05
      CenterForOpenScience/waterbutler,develop,cos,upstream/cos-develop,reference,0000000000000000000000000000000000000000,2026-11-05
    adopted_prs[1]{repo,number,title,reason,status}:
      RDM-waterbutler,101,"Python 3.13, dependency update, multi-stage image (WIP)","vulnerability remediation (M4)",adopted
    candidate_prs[1]{repo,number,title,reason,status}:
      RDM-waterbutler,93,"S3 SigV4",feature,candidate
    base_image: python:3.6-slim-buster
    base_image_digest: null
    target_image:
      M4: "python:3.13-slim multi-stage, non-root"
      M5: null
    profile: core
    platforms[2]: linux/arm64,linux/amd64
    note: null

上の全部ゼロの SHA は例のための仮の値です。本物のマニフェストには現れません。このブロックは説明のための例であって manifest/upstreams.json の写しではないので、<!-- canonical: ... --> の宣言は付けません（SPEC-06 §4）。マニフェストを写すブロック（たとえば SPEC-00 §2）には宣言を付けます。

docs.title: 4. 規則
docs.text:
1. SHA を固定する。 すべての upstreams[].sha は、fetched_at の時点でそのブランチに実在する 40 文字のコミットです。ブランチ名だけでは足りません。
  2. マニフェストの変更は PR で行う。 develop 上の upstreams.json を直接編集する人はいません。SHA が進む通常の経路は週次の統合 PR（SPEC-05 §3）です。PR の採用・却下もマニフェストの PR で、reason を書きます。
  3. 統合の順番は固定: status: merged の public の上流をマージ、次に private の上流をマージ、最後に adopted_prs を並び順に適用。public の上流がない部品（非公開サブシステム）は private の上流から始めます。cos の上流（status: reference）はマージせず、比較だけに使います。
  4. 「矛盾なく」とは次のすべてを満たすこと:
  5. 同じ上流リポジトリの同じブランチについて、二つの部品が異なる SHA を参照していない。
  6. すべての adopted_prs[] が、固定した上流から組んだ統合ブランチにきれいに（衝突なく）当たる。
  7. upstreams.toon が、grdm-dev manifest toon が upstreams.json から出す結果と 1 バイトも違わない。
  8. 名前を書いた integration_repo がすべて存在し、develop と、upstreams[] の各要素につき一本の追跡ブランチ（名前はその tracking_branch と完全に同じ）を持つ。
  9. 名前だけを書く。 repo と integration_repo は裸の名前（RDM-osf.io-dev2027）です。http や git@ で始まる値、github.com を含む値は不正です。
  10. 決まっていない上流は status: candidate で載せる。 追跡ブランチにはミラーするが、マージはしない。例: RDM-osf.io-private（ブランチ fix/sec-test、追跡ブランチ upstream/private-sec-test-fix-sec-test）は所有者が決めるまで候補です（計画書 §7）。
  11. 追跡ブランチの名前は一つの規則で決める: upstream/<kind>-<branch>。<branch> は上流のブランチ名の / をすべて - に置き換えたもの。一つの部品に同じ kind の上流が二つあるときは、二つ目は kind の後ろに短いタグを挟む: upstream/<kind>-<tag>-<branch>。例: RDM-ember-osf-web（master）→ upstream/public-master、RDM-ember-osf-web-master-private → upstream/private-master、RDM-OASys-main-private → upstream/private-main、CenterForOpenScience/osf.io → upstream/cos-develop、RDM-osf.io-private（fix/sec-test）→ upstream/private-sec-test-fix-sec-test。同じ規則を SPEC-05 §1 と ADR-01 §3 にも書いています。

docs.title: 5. 検査: grdm-dev manifest check
docs.text:
リポジトリのルートで実行します。終了コード 0 が合格。不合格なら指摘ごとに一行出して 20（manifest が不正。SPEC-02 §6）で終わります。

grdm-dev manifest check

検査は次の順で行います。

checks[13]{id,rule,severity}:
  MC-01,"upstreams.json が JSON として読め、schema_version 1 の形に合う",error
  MC-02,"部品の id が重複せず ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ に合う",error
  MC-03,"role が core|infra|subsystem のいずれか。services が空でない配列",error
  MC-04,"integration_repo が ^RDM-[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+-dev2027$ に合う。infra は null",error
  MC-05,"integration_branch が develop。infra は null",error
  MC-06,"sha が ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ に合う。base_image_digest は null か sha256:<16 進 64 文字>。fetched_at が未来でない ISO 日付。prebuilt_image があるときは name@sha256:<16 進 64 文字> で、空でない note を伴い、URL や非公開リポジトリの参照でなく、infra に無い",error
  MC-07,"どの値にも http、git@、github.com、トークンらしい文字列が含まれない",error
  MC-08,"同じ (repo, branch) の組は全部品で一つの sha",error
  MC-09,"adopted_prs の status は adopted。candidate_prs は candidate|rejected。upstreams の status は merged|reference|candidate で cos は reference。number は正の整数",error
  MC-10,"profile と platforms が許された値だけ。core の部品は両 platform を持つ",error
  MC-11,"upstreams.toon が grdm-dev manifest toon の出力と一致",error
  MC-12,"--remote 付き: 各 integration_repo が develop と列挙した全 tracking_branch を持ち、各 sha がその tracking_branch から到達できる",error
  MC-13,"すべての tracking_branch が規則 7（upstream/<kind>[-<tag>]-<branch の / を - に置換>）に合う",error

--remote はネットワークと認証情報が要るので、公開であるこのリポジトリの CI ではなく、非公開の -dev2027 側の CI で実行します。SPEC-06 §8 の文書検査は、文書内に引用した TOON ブロックに MC-11 を使い回します。

docs.title: 6. 誰が変えるか
docs.text: 変更 起票 レビュー マージ 週次の SHA 前進 AID エージェント（週次ジョブ。SPEC-05） REV（Codex Astra）。検査は QAE（Claude Code Fable） 所有者 PR の採用・却下 AID または QAE。reason 付き REV 所有者 target_image の変更 QAE。節目の計画を参照 REV 所有者

docs.title: Glossary / 用語
docs.text: Term English note 日本語注 Manifest A packing list that says exactly what goes into the build. ビルドに何が入るかを正確に書いた明細書。 Upstream The original repository we copy code from. コードを写してくる元のリポジトリ。 SHA The 40-character fingerprint that names one commit. 一つのコミットを指す 40 文字の指紋。 Pull request (PR) A proposed change waiting to be reviewed and merged. レビューとマージを待つ変更の提案。 Schema The agreed shape of a data file: which fields, which types. データファイルの決まった形。どの項目がどの型か。 Profile A named set of components the installer starts together. インストーラーがまとめて起動する部品の組に付けた名前。 Token A secret string that proves who you are to a computer. コンピュータに「自分は誰か」を示す秘密の文字列。

docs.title: SPEC-02 Installer CLI / インストーラー CLI
docs.text:
Summary: The contract of the two entry points that install the GakuNin RDM developer environment: the thin bootstrap installer/install.sh and the Python command grdm-dev with its subcommands, profiles, flags, exit codes, and directory layout. 概要: GakuNin RDM 開発環境を導入する二つの入口、薄い起動スクリプト installer/install.sh と Python コマンド grdm-dev の契約。サブコマンド、プロファイル、フラグ、終了コード、ディレクトリ構成を定める。

docs.title: 1. Scope and goal
docs.text:
The installer turns a fresh checkout of this repository into a running GakuNin RDM developer environment with one command, on the hosts listed in §8. It never needs sudo (a way to run a command as the computer's administrator), never changes network settings on the host, and can be run again at any time without harm. Everything it creates lives under runtime/, which is ignored by Git.

Glossary notes. An installer is a program that prepares other programs so they can run. A CLI (command line interface) is a program you drive by typing commands. A container is a box that holds one program and everything it needs, so it runs the same on any computer. Docker Compose is the tool that starts many containers together from one description file. A manifest is the list that says exactly which version of each source repository we use (SPEC-01).

docs.title: 2.1 installer/install.sh — thin bootstrap
docs.text:
install.sh does four things and nothing else:

  1. Runs with the bash that ships with macOS (version 3.2), so it uses no feature newer than that: no associative arrays, no mapfile, no ${var,,}.
  2. Finds python3 and checks that it is 3.11 or newer. If not, it prints how to install one for the detected OS and exits with code 10.
  3. Creates a virtual environment (a private folder of Python and its libraries, separate from the system) at .venv/ and installs the installer/ package into it with pip install -e installer.
  4. Hands every argument to .venv/bin/grdm-dev install "$@" and exits with that command's exit code.

OS differences are not written in install.sh. They live in installer/grdm_dev/host.py. User-facing messages come from installer/grdm_dev/messages.tsv (one line per code, English and Japanese columns) so that the script and the Python command say the same thing.

flowchart TD
  A[./installer/install.sh --yes] --> B{python3 >= 3.11?}
  B -- no --> X10[exit 10: how to install Python]
  B -- yes --> C[create .venv/ and pip install -e installer]
  C --> D[grdm-dev doctor]
  D -- unsupported host --> X10b[exit 10]
  D -- Docker missing --> X11[exit 11]
  D --> E[grdm-dev plan]
  E -- manifest invalid --> X20[exit 20]
  E --> F[grdm-dev secrets init]
  F --> G[grdm-dev compose render]
  G --> H[grdm-dev build]
  H -- failed --> X30[exit 30]
  H --> I[grdm-dev up]
  I --> J[grdm-dev health --network]
  J -- failed --> X40[exit 40]
  J --> K[grdm-dev scan]
  K -- gate failed --> X50[exit 50]
  K --> L[grdm-dev report]
  L --> Z[exit 0 and print URL http://127.0.0.1:5000]

docs.title: 2.2 grdm-dev — the Python command
docs.text:
grdm-dev is the package installer/grdm_dev/, exposed as a console script. Rules:

  • Standard library first. The command itself has no third-party dependency. The manifest is JSON (read with json), the host is read with platform, shutil, socket, and subprocess, and the generated Compose file is written as JSON, which Docker Compose accepts because JSON is valid YAML. PyYAML is therefore not required.
  • Optional extra accept. pip install -e "installer[accept]" adds pytest, pytest-playwright, and playwright. Only grdm-dev accept imports them (SPEC-04).
  • External tools are called as subprocesses and checked by doctor: docker (27 or newer) with the Compose plugin (v2 or newer) and buildx, trivy, gitleaks, and semgrep for scan, the OWASP ZAP container image for scan --dynamic, and mkdocs for docs. A missing scanner makes scan exit 51 (SPEC-03 §8).
  • Every subcommand supports --json, which prints the same report as machine-readable JSON instead of TOON (a compact text form of JSON, see SPEC-06 §4).

docs.title: 3. Subcommands
docs.text: Subcommand Contract Touches Docker doctor Detects OS (macOS, Ubuntu, WSL2), CPU (arm64, amd64), memory, free disk, Docker ≥ 27, Compose plugin (v2 or newer), buildx. Prints a TOON report. Exit 10 if the host is unsupported, 11 if Docker is missing or not running. read-only plan Resolves manifest + profile and prints which images would be built and which services started, with the published ports (§4). Changes nothing. Exit 20 if the manifest fails SPEC-01 checks. no secrets init / secrets rotate init writes random secrets (database passwords, Django secret key, CAS keys) into runtime/.env with file mode 0600. Never writes a default or example password. Refuses to overwrite an existing file unless --force. rotate regenerates every secret, changes the live PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ passwords, recreates the containers so they receive the new environment, and verifies that the old credentials are rejected; any failure restores the previous runtime/.env and exits 40. Used after a red-team capture (SPEC-03 §6). no / yes compose render Writes runtime/docker-compose.yml from manifest + profile: the internal network grdm plus the publishing-only grdm-edge (--egress <services> attaches more, recorded in runtime/.env; SPEC-03 §3.2), per-component platform: from the manifest's build_platform, ports published only on 127.0.0.1 (§4), non-root user: for every service, read_only, cap_drop, and resource limits (mem_limit, cpus, pids_limit) scaled from the memory doctor detected, with per-service exceptions from manifest/hardening.json (SPEC-03 §3.3), platform: chosen from doctor, named volumes mapped under runtime/volumes/. Follows ADR-02. no build Builds images with docker buildx. The platform is, in order of precedence, --platform, the component's build_platform in the manifest (for example linux/amd64 for components whose EOL base cannot be built for arm64, run under emulation), otherwise the host platform; the image is loaded locally. A component with prebuilt_image (SPEC-01) is not built: the digest-pinned image is pulled and reported as prebuilt (pull-failed → exit 30). --push pushes the multi-arch manifest to ghcr.io/rcosdp/<name> (private). Exit 30 on failure. yes up / down / reset up starts the profile and waits for health; down stops containers and keeps volumes; reset stops and deletes runtime/volumes/ after a confirmation (skipped by --yes). yes health Checks every service's health endpoint. With --network, also lists listening sockets on the host and fails (exit 40) if any container port is bound to a non-loopback address. read-only scan Runs the whole security gate of SPEC-03: baseline controls, Trivy SBOM (software bill of materials: the list of all parts inside an image) and CVE list, gitleaks, Semgrep, and OWASP ZAP; writes runtime/reports/scan_<date>.json plus TOON, and diffs findings against manifest/allowlist.json and manifest/allowlist.baseline.json for the milestone in manifest/milestone.json. Gate per ADR-03: M1–M3 report only, M4 exit 50 on HIGH, M5 exit 50 on CRITICAL or HIGH. Flags --baseline, --secrets, --dynamic run one part only. Exit 51 if a scanner cannot run, 52 if --dynamic was asked for while services are unhealthy. read-only redteam preflight Verifies, before an AI red-team run, that the attacker container of the red-team Compose project is isolated (proved with a reachable canary, see SPEC-03 §6), that only the containers named in manifest/redteam-targets.json are attached, and that the approval record is present and current. Exit 53 if either check fails. See SPEC-03 §6. yes (starts and removes a canary container and network for the probe) accept Runs the Playwright Python acceptance suite in the same .venv/. --only <scenario> runs one scenario; --seed creates the disposable test users. Exit 60 on any failing test. See SPEC-04. read-only upstream mirror / upstream integrate Runs the daily mirror or the weekly integration of SPEC-05 by hand. Needs Git credentials for the private -dev2027 repositories; never run in this repository's CI. no (Git only) manifest check / manifest toon check validates manifest/upstreams.json (SPEC-01 §5) and verifies that every TOON excerpt in docs/ and manifest/upstreams.toon agree with it. Exit 20 on mismatch. toon prints the excerpt that upstreams.toon must equal. no docs build / docs check build runs MkDocs into site/. check enforces SPEC-06 §8: anchors, Jump line, relative links, TOON consistency, Version line. no report Bundles the latest reports of doctor, plan, health, scan, and accept into runtime/reports/<timestamp>.toon and .json. no install The sequence shown in the flowchart. Stops at the first non-zero step. yes

docs.title: 4. Profiles and published ports
docs.text:
profiles[3]{name,services,note}:
  minimum,"web api postgres elasticsearch rabbitmq fakecas",smallest set that shows a login and a project page
  core,"minimum + admin worker wb wb_worker mfr unoconv ember_osf_web cas wiki mongo sharejs elasticsearch6 redis y_websocket","the six core repositories with their infrastructure, plus y_websocket for Wiki collaborative editing"
  full,"core + rdmcp aipf_mcp_data_grdm oasys shibboleth_sp test_idp",everything; shibboleth_sp replaces fakecas

Service names follow the upstream docker-compose.yml of RDM-osf.io so that existing guides keep working, and they are the services[] values of the manifest (SPEC-01 §3). The shibboleth Compose profile and the fakecas service are mutually exclusive: compose render --profile full --auth shibboleth removes fakecas and adds shibboleth_sp and test_idp; the default for full is fakecas. y_websocket belongs to core, not full, because Wiki collaborative editing is an M2 acceptance scenario (C4 in SPEC-04 §4); the manifest's profile for the y-websocket component is core accordingly (SPEC-01 §3).

Published ports. This table is the only place where default host ports are defined; ADR-02, SPEC-03, and REF-01 point here. Every port is published on 127.0.0.1 only.

ports[7]{service,host_port,profile,url}:
  web,5000,minimum,http://127.0.0.1:5000
  api,8000,minimum,http://127.0.0.1:8000
  admin,8001,core,http://127.0.0.1:8001
  wb,7777,core,http://127.0.0.1:7777
  mfr,7778,core,http://127.0.0.1:7778
  fakecas,8080,minimum,http://127.0.0.1:8080
  ember_osf_web,4200,core,http://127.0.0.1:4200

All other services (wiki, cas, y_websocket, the subsystems, test_idp, databases and queues) are reached only inside the Compose network; when one of them needs a browser-facing port, compose render assigns it and plan prints it. compose render writes every chosen host port to runtime/.env as GRDM_PORT_<SERVICE> (upper case), which the acceptance tests read (SPEC-04 §1). If a default port is already in use (macOS AirPlay on 5000 is the known case), compose render takes the next free port and records the change in the install report; exit 12 is returned only when no free port is found.

docs.title: 5. Flags
docs.text: Flag Meaning --yes Answer every question with its default. Required when no terminal is attached. --profile minimum\|core\|full Default core. Saved in runtime/.env as GRDM_PROFILE and reused on later runs. --platform linux/arm64,linux/amd64 Override the platforms for build. Default: host platform only. --no-open Do not open the browser after up. --json Print reports as JSON instead of TOON.

docs.title: 6. Exit codes
docs.text:
exit_codes[13]{code,meaning}:
  0,success
  2,"usage error: unknown flag or bad value"
  10,"host unsupported: OS, CPU, memory, or Python too old"
  11,"Docker missing, not running, or Compose / buildx plugin absent"
  12,a required port on 127.0.0.1 is in use and no free alternative was found
  20,manifest invalid or TOON excerpt disagrees with JSON
  30,image build failed
  40,"health check failed, or a port listens on a non-loopback address"
  50,security scan gate failed for the current milestone
  51,"scanner could not run: tool missing or vulnerability database download failed"
  52,"services not healthy, so scan --dynamic could not run"
  53,"red-team preflight failed: egress reachable or a target outside redteam-targets.json"
  60,acceptance test failed

Numbers are never reused for a new meaning; a new cause gets a new number. The canonical table is installer/grdm_dev/messages.tsv, and this TOON block must agree with it (manifest check verifies). Codes 50–53 are described in detail in SPEC-03 §8.

docs.title: 7. Behavior rules
docs.text:
• Non-interactive. When stdin is not a terminal and --yes is absent, every question is answered "no" and the command exits 2 with a hint to add --yes.
  • Idempotent. Running any subcommand twice gives the same result. secrets init keeps existing secrets, compose render overwrites only the generated file, build uses the buildx cache, up is a no-op for healthy services.
  • No secrets in Git. runtime/ is in .gitignore. docs check and the CI secret scan fail if a file under runtime/ or a value that looks like a secret is committed.
  • No host network changes. The loopback alias 192.168.168.167 from the old guide is not created; compose render rewrites the upstream local.py and .docker-compose.*.env settings to use service names inside the Compose network and 127.0.0.1 for the browser (ADR-02).
  • No -private code here. The installer clones the integration repositories by name and SHA from the manifest at run time; this public repository holds no code from them (POL-01).

docs.title: 8. Supported hosts
docs.text: Host CPU Support macOS 14 or newer with Docker Desktop arm64 official (M2 acceptance runs here) Ubuntu 24.04 with Docker Engine amd64, arm64 official Windows 11 with WSL2 (Ubuntu 24.04) and Docker Desktop amd64 required to work; checked in CI as build-only Other Linux, macOS on Intel any best-effort; doctor warns and continues

docs.title: 9. Directory layout
docs.text:
layout:
  installer/install.sh: bash 3.2 bootstrap
  installer/pyproject.toml: package metadata, console script grdm-dev, extra accept
  installer/grdm_dev/:
    cli.py: argument parsing, subcommand dispatch, exit codes
    host.py: OS, CPU, memory, disk, Docker detection
    manifest.py: load and validate manifest/upstreams.json, TOON comparison
    secrets.py: random secret generation, runtime/.env with mode 0600
    compose.py: render runtime/docker-compose.yml from manifest and profile
    build.py: buildx wrapper, platform list, optional push
    health.py: service health and loopback-only check
    scan.py: baseline controls, Trivy SBOM and CVE, gitleaks, Semgrep, ZAP, allow-list diff, staged gate (SPEC-03)
    redteam.py: red-team preflight (SPEC-03 §6)
    upstream.py: mirror and integrate (SPEC-05)
    accept.py: run pytest-playwright in the same venv
    docs.py: MkDocs build and SPEC-06 checks
    report.py: bundle TOON and JSON reports
    messages.tsv: exit code, English message, Japanese message
  installer/tests/: unittest, files named test_*.py
  installer/acceptance/: Playwright Python, see SPEC-04
  manifest/:
    upstreams.json: canonical manifest (SPEC-01)
    upstreams.toon: excerpt generated by grdm-dev manifest toon (SPEC-01)
    allowlist.json: accepted findings (SPEC-03 §5.1)
    allowlist.baseline.json: allow-list count at the last milestone exit, owner-maintained (SPEC-03 §5.1)
    milestone.json: current milestone, owner-maintained (SPEC-03 §5.2)
    hardening.json: per-service exceptions to read-only root and cap_drop, with reasons (SPEC-03 §3.3)
    redteam-targets.json: container names the AI red team may touch (SPEC-03 §6)
  runtime/: generated, git-ignored (.env, docker-compose.yml, volumes/, reports/)

docs.title: 10. Tests
docs.text: python3 -m unittest discover -s installer/tests must pass on every PR. Each module has a test_<module>.py that covers at least one success case and one rejection case, and every rejection case asserts the exit code from §6. Docker is never required by unit tests: host.py and build.py take an injectable runner so tests pass fake docker output. Integration and acceptance tiers are defined in SPEC-04.
